name: myocyte enhancer factor 2D
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MEF2D encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2D. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell differentiation.

function.text: MEF2D encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2D. Based in part on similarity, it mediates cellular functions not only in skeletal and cardiac muscle development, but also in neuronal differentiation and survival. It plays diverse roles in the control of cell growth, survival and apoptosis via p38 MAPK signaling in muscle-specific and/or growth factor-related transcription. It contributes to the regulation of neuronal apoptosis.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2D have been reported in b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.
